The first exposes thread_ts 1690000123.111, which loop_presentation_001 also lists, so a thread lookup alone resolves it. The second keeps only channel_id, which matches nothing, and the message contains no order id, policy number, invoice number or amount for extract_identifiers to recover. The one deterministic signal left is the actor Sarah matching the owner of node_presentation_collect, which is weak on its own: an owner name is not unique to a loop and must score too low to short-circuit. This is the fixture that forces the semantic path.
